relaunchGate.reason: Runtime preflight hardening is deployed, but cleanup-race Convex failures are still actively visible and the reset contract is not yet autonomy-safe.

greenSignals: Manifest-scoped V3 snapshot is preflight_clean and launch_ready
Temporal queue health shows one active worker identity with zero backlog
No recurring missing-row Convex callback failures during normal idle/reset periods
No manual safe-heal is required to keep a relaunch healthy
yellowSignals: A newly deployed worker is still overlapping the prior worker identity but backlog remains zero
Runtime patch is deployed but has not yet been proven end-to-end by a fresh full V3 pass
redSignals: Repeated packages/worker:projectProcessState or recordLlmAttemptFinish missing-row failures continue
Reset requires ad hoc destructive fallbacks to become fully clean
A new relaunch hits stale_projection again without a new differentiated root cause
missingObservability: A first-class counter or trace event for ignored late callbacks after cleanup
A machine-readable reset drain completion signal that says destructive deletion is now legal
A codex/lab surface that summarizes autonomy gate status directly instead of requiring operator assembly
